Chhath Puja 2026 : : lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar bihar aur jharkhand ke bajaron men raunak barh gaee hai. chhath puja ki taiyariyon ke bich bajaron men shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir umar rahi hai. sup, daura, phal, nariyal, ganna, phul-mala aur puja ki any samagri ki jamkar kharidari ho rahi hai.
Chhath ke rang men range bajaron men har taraph utsah aur bhakti ka mahaul najar aa raha hai. dukandaron ko bhi achchhe karobar ki ummid hai. dekhie bihar aur jharkhand ke chhath bajaron ki ye khas tasviren.
